messages:
maria_sales: Syndicate just dropped an RFI + security questionnaire. They want a 2-week POC (dedicated), ability to use their HSM, and a pricing breakdown for ~50M tokens/month. I've uploaded the files: rfi_syndicate_v3.pdf and syndicate_security_qs.xlsx. Can we triage what we can answer quickly and what's a blocker?

sam_se: Thanks — I can take POC scheduling and runbook. Quick Q: do they expect a production-like dataset inside the POC (PII masked) or synthetic samples? That affects infra + SLA for the trial.

maria_sales: Customer PM said "sanitized subset of real logs" is preferred. They can provide a small redacted sample within a week.

alex_eng: For Dedicated POC we need: network peering to their VPC (or customer VPN), IP allowlist, and HSM/KMS details if they want key ownership. Timeline wise: infra ready ~3-5 business days after peering and keys confirmed.

nina_sec: Re: security questionnaire — we can answer SOC 2 and pen test sections now. HSM: we support AWS KMS + BYOK for Private; on-prem HSM requires an Ops runbook and uplift (we'll need architecture signoff). I'll flag 6 questions in the spreadsheet that require legal/security redlines.

jen_finance: Pricing: rough host vs dedicated comps for 50M tokens/month:
- Hosted API (typical): ~$0.0006 / token => ~ $30k/mo (text gen rate example).
- Dedicated baseline (reserved capacity): starting around $25k/mo for a small pool + infra cost; with SLA and isolation expect a committed minimum + consumption overage.
- Private/on-prem: license + install + support (one-time + annual).
These are rough; I'll put together a two-column hosted vs dedicated estimate by EOD.

sam_se: POC runbook draft (short):
```
Week 0: Kick, NDA, access list, sample dataset due
Day 1-3: Network peering + credential exchange + HSM verification
Day 4-6: Provision dedicated pool, deploy model variant, smoke tests
Day 7-10: Customer runs integration tests, latency/cost baselining
Day 11-14: Eval session, handoff doc, decision meeting
```
We should include an SLO matrix for latency and token throughput to avoid scope creep.

alex_eng: A couple of technical notes:
- For 50M tokens/month at expected request distribution, we recommend enabling prefix KV caching and a 1.5x batching policy to reduce unit cost.
- Quantization options: q4f32 gives best perf/quality balance for their LLM family.
- If they insist on an on-prem HSM during POC, time to provision + test will likely add 1 week.

nina_sec: On the spreadsheet I marked items that need customer-supplied attestations (e.g., data retention policy, resurfacing rights). Also: we can offer a data deletion cert at POC end if that helps.

maria_sales: Nice — can you add short answers to the RFI section "deployment options" and "key mgmt"? I started a section but it's rough. Customer asked for a capability matrix that compares Hosted / Dedicated / Private across: SLA, data isolation, onboarding time, and cost.

jen_finance: I'll draft the matrix. Quick placeholders:
- SLA: Hosted (best-effort + tiers), Dedicated (SLA-backed), Private (customer-managed with support SLAs).
- Data isolation: Hosted (logical), Dedicated (resource isolation), Private (customer-managed).
- Onboarding time: Hosted (hours-days), Dedicated (days-weeks), Private (weeks-months).
- Cost: Hosted (usage), Dedicated (commit + infra), Private (license + infra).
I'll attach a short PDF with numbers.

alex_eng: Potential enterprise blocker: they listed FedRAMP in their compliance section. We don't have FedRAMP as a hosted offering — we can support through Private deployments or partner-managed environments. Mark that for sales/legal.

nina_sec: Agreed — add that to the "risks" block and offer mitigations: Private deployment, audited partner, or limited-scope FedRAMP-hosted partner.

deploy-bot: Deployment request queued: request 198765-POC-Syndicate; estimated provision ETA 202s.

sam_se: I'll push the POC scoping doc into the thread (link: /files/syndicate_poc_scope.docx) and add the checklist for credentials and sample data.

maria_sales: Perfect. Next steps: Sam to share the scope + calendar invite for kick next Tue, Jen to drop the pricing matrix PDF, Nina to return redlined security answers for the 6 flagged items, Alex to confirm infra steps and any extra lead time for HSM. I'll reply to the customer with a 2-week plan and ask for the redacted sample by EOW. :thumbsup:

jen_finance: Dropping the matrix now. Upload: syndicate_pricing_matrix_v1.pdf

nina_sec: I'll get the redlines back by tomorrow AM.

alex_eng: If they want a test harness we can provide a small k6 load script and a sample latency report template. I'll attach after smoke tests.

maria_sales: Awesome — thanks team. I'll wait for attachments and then reply to Syndicate with the proposed plan.

sam_se: on it.

maria_sales: (adding tag) @sam_se @alex_eng @nina_sec @jen_finance — please react when your piece is uploaded so I can assemble the RFI bundle.
